notes.title: October patch notes
notes.content:
Greetings snipers,

Control has issued an update regarding the recent save game issues that a limited number of you reported following our September patch.

At the time, we asked you to not pull the trigger and start a new game, as this could overwrite your existing progress. We’re pleased to confirm the issues identified with the save system have now been addressed in today’s patch:

If you created a new save following the installation of the September patch, you will be able to continue your campaign with this new update. Similarly, any save games created before last month’s patch are also safe to continue. Unfortunately, any save games loaded during September’s patch are permanently gone due to unforeseen corruption issues.

We’ve also fixed an issue with the Steam language option, so the game now boots in the chosen language. 

- The SGWC Team

[b][u]October patch notes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Save system issues have been addressed:
[*] Saves not loaded on September’s patch will be safe to load on the new build. Players who have not attempted to play the game since then will be safe.
[*] Saves created on the September patch can be continued on the new October build. 
[*] However, saves loaded on the previous patch released in September are unfortunately gone permanently due to unforeseen corruption issues.
[*] Removed 20GB of unnecessary textures
[*] Fixed a language issue where the game would boot in English regardless of the selection made in Steam properties. Now boots in the selected language.
[/list]

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts - September Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Snipers, [/h3]

Earlier this month, we rolled out a new update to [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts[/i] that increased texture resolution, disabled network mode, and fixed issues related to audio and data loss in local saves.

Regrettably, we were unable to push patch notes at the same time the update was rolled out, which resulted in some confusion regarding what it included, especially since it was a large patch. We apologised and, as soon as we were able to, shared the update details with you all. 

However, since the update launched, it’s come to our attention that some players are experiencing an issue whereby they can’t locate/access their previous saves. If you’re experiencing this issue, rest assured that your saved data is still intact. The problem is related to how the game is recognising your save. [b]Please avoid starting a new game, as this could overwrite your existing progress.[/b]

Solving this save game issue is a top priority for us, and we’ll update you with further details as quickly as we have them. We appreciate your continued patience until then. 

– The SGWC Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35189422/f9b5649f9f98afc07d79feb56da3838b47da42e8.png[/img]

notes.title: Free Major Expansion, Butcher’s Banquet, Is Available Now In SGW Contracts 2!
notes.content:
You’ve been more patient than a professional sniper awaiting that perfect shot. But get ready to pull the trigger, as the wait is finally over… 

As of today, all versions of [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2[/i] will now include ‘Butcher’s Banquet’: a major expansion which introduces an entirely new, unexplored region - The Temple - complete with all-new objectives and some of your most deadly contracts, yet. In addition, today’s patch also added Chinese VO to the main game. Check out the dramatic trailer below…

[previewyoutube=BSWOpPK05oY;full][/previewyoutube]
The stunning desert-like area, made up of luscious oases, dramatic waterfalls, and mysterious temples, might look picturesque, but make no mistake - it’s no holiday destination. Following the recent turmoil in Kuamar, a new threat has been allowed to surface. The movement is led by the notorious Mahmoud Zarza... aka ‘The Butcher’. Unpredictable and incredibly dangerous (hence the monika), we need you to eliminate him and his equally-lethal associates, and in doing so, put a stop to the faction's rapid uprising… as only you know how. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/8de3ae82835f569ebe0cf2a1d8a14e800043d094.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/79a2ea6d7d349826216818e14265d9ee0fee8379.png[/img]

In other news, new DLC also dropped today! Designed in direct collaboration with CYRILmp4, one of Europe’s leading FPS content creators, this latest Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 DLC weapon skin pays tribute to the sharpshooter’s super-sleek monochrome branding. 

A master with the sniper rifle, Cyril’s known to his community for his insanely accurate aim, and while his branded weapon skin might not grant you the same level of precision, at least you can look almost as good as the deadeye-streamer while lining up that headshot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/58100cc337c3df8e9235969e9955fb244906a2b0.png[/img]

notes.title: OUT NOW! SGW Contracts 2 Releases Today Alongside SHROUD DLC
notes.content:
Snipers, it’s finally time to take up arms and prepare for mission deployment. Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 is OUT NOW!

The newest entry in the best-selling first person sniping franchise, this eagerly awaited sequel promises to take the series to new heights (and lengths!) with a host of new features, not least of all, the further-than-ever extreme-range sniping. With many targets now over 1000m away, the dramatic single player campaign promises to challenge even the most proficient of FPS players! 

[i]Calibrate the distance. Adjust for windspeed. Allow for bullet drop. 
[/i]
[i]Now breathe. And squeeze the trigger. [/i]

[previewyoutube=0fXL6t-PzFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Story[/h2]

Step into the military boots of Raven, Sniper Assassin, as he embarks on a new series of contracts in a lawless region of the Middle East, located along the Lebanese and Syrian borders. Tasked with a seemingly impossible task, your mission is to topple an insidious criminal syndicate led by the region’s corrupt President, Bibi Rashida.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/177a6e7393ae78a6a951a5718624e050e9a0b651.png[/img]

[h2]Customise your Arsenal & Explore 5 Extensive Regions[/h2]

Guided by advanced intel, you’ll need to navigate 5 distinct sandbox-style regions in order to complete 21 varied (but equally lethal) contract targets. To aid you in your assignment, you’ll have access to the most powerful Sniper Rifles in existence, able to take out hostiles with utmost precision, as well as a wide selection of pistols, assault rifles, and shotguns, not to mention a variety of gadgets and explosives to boot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/d30e9b81f9450deefe1df55ee3ed2a002e364780.png[/img]

[h2]Plan your approach[/h2]

With every contract posing its own unique challenge, you’ll need to fully customise your loadout to ensure it's optimised for the job at hand. Missions can be completed in a number of ways, with a series of rewards for achieving all objectives. Earn cash and experience points to upgrade your arsenal, unlock new skills… and ultimately, become the Ghost Warrior! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/f56a19bf8af773866e7e8fafd9ab34f0231a5625.png[/img]

[h2]shroud DLC[/h2]

Also launching today is the first in a series of influencer-themed DLC drops. Top FPS streamer, shroud, has worked with the studio to create his very own DLC package, containing an exclusive Sniper Rifle, tuned to his unique style of play, in addition to a branded weapon skin. Zoom in for a closer look at the exclusive pack here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/acda7bc7b67feccb519d35620053e0765162894e.png[/img]

[h2]Out Now - Standard and Deluxe Editions[/h2]

Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 is out now! And if you fancy getting an upper hand on your enemy, make sure you check out the Deluxe Edition, containing an array of high power firearms:

[list]
[*] [b]ZXR .45 ACP[/b] - As well as the only silenced SMG in the game, the ZXR .45 ACP also shoots the biggest rounds, making it one powerful addition to your arsenal.
[*] [b]Kings Arms Sawn Off Shotgun[/b] - The only shotgun to go into the sidearm slot, usually reserved for pistols - a very tempting trade-off.
[*] [b]Giovanni Mk12 Auto [/b]- The only silenced shotgun in game. The enemy won’t know what hit it.
[*] [b]Prescot SR-9 Pistol[/b] - Fitted with the best silencer in-game, this is a must for close-quarter tactical combat.
[*] Fire and Ice Weapon Skin
[*] Paint Spill Weapon Skin
[*] Round Geometrical Painted Weapon Skin
[*] Dark Hex Camo Weapon Skin
[*] Graffiti Weapon Skin
[*] Dark Sky Skin
[/list]

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts Patch 1.05 out now.
notes.content:
This patch includes a number of bug fixes and improvements made to the game. Please read through the patch notes to see what’s been changed.

[h3]GENERAL[/h3]

Fixed - Random crash while playing contracts.
Stability issues further improvements.
Save System further improvements.
Fixed - Problem that some players didn’t get tokens from objectives.
Now all shotguns provide vibration feedback for controllers.
Fixed - Problem where there are no possibilities to looting bounties’ body.
Fixed - Problem where video settings are not saved.
Fixed - Problem when player can get stuck after planting a mine under a building.
Resolved - Problem where player has no ability to tag drones after reloading save.
Fixed - Problem where player has issues switching ammo in shotguns.
Fixed - Where enemies that are running to cover after an explosion sometimes ignore the player.
Fixed - Minor bugs with localization.
Improved - Minor fixes on maps where player could get stuck.

[h3]Altai Mountains[/h3]
Fixed - Dialogue overlapping in some situations.
Improved - Extreme navigation on levels.
Improving sequence where AI will now return to route after being interrupted.

[h3]Kolchak Harbor[/h3]
The indicator for completed objectives no longer appears after the load.

[h3]Beketov Valley[/h3]
Villa`s modules lod settings fix.
Spawning points after "load last checkpoint" are fixed.
Fixed - Invisible stairways at Dacha.
Fixed - Minor bugs with shadows.
Added - Missing extreme navigations in some places.

[h3]Arakcheyev Fortres[/h3]
Redundant Mortar remove from barracks.
Traffick System fix on barracks area.
Fixed - Player receiving a double reward for completing the Antanasia contract.

[h3]Sibirskaya - 7 junction[/h3]
Fixed - Challenge where player is asked to kill Kurchatov from 100m+, this now works properly.

If you encounter any problem please contact us on support@cigames.com, we will do our best to fix them in next patch.

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts Patch 1.04 out now.
notes.content:
This patch includes a number of bug fixes and improvements made to the game. Please read through the patch notes to see what’s been changed.

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]
●	Fixed - [Weapons] - [UI] - Armor Piercing bullet icon doesn't fit its window and is enlarged
●	Fixed - [Weapon] - Some bullets are not properly scaled compared to normal-sized bullets
●	Improved -UI add back button
●	Fixed - Kell-T has present replace me when dropped with attachments
●	Improved - AI squad missions

●	Improved - Mi17 Explosion Range and Pressure
●	Fixed - Issue where mine trigger was not registered again after loading last checkpoint

●	Fixed - Reward tokens for bounty complete

[h1]Altai Mountains[/h1]
●	Fixed - One light in Outpost 1 is flickering, doesn't shine (but gives light around) and after destruction

●	Fixed - After killing Ivanovsky and picking up virus samples, proper VO is not played
●	Fixed - Dialogues are overlapping when moving under a pipe
●	Fixed - Snowstorm- Exfiltrate after challenge (second playthrough)
●	Fixed - Bounty melee kill with auto loot will now not display Location to loot body

[h1]Kolchak Harbor[/h1]
●	Fixed - Unable to use exfil after completing all contracts
●	Improved - C4 location while using scanning mode
●	Added Ex-nav to lower edges of helipad in Containers area on Kolchak Harbor.
●	Fixed - When Player saves game by exiting Control Room through openable doors and load last checkpoint - textures don't load until any movement
●	Fixed - Soldiers which cross the bridge disappear if Seeker goes down enters the hotel using main entrance and gets back using sniping spot
●	Fixed - AI Soldier may shoot Player through concrete barrier in Containers area when he stands close to it
●	Fixed - extreme navigations from metal barriers under Helipad
●	Fixed - Player may stuck in water in Warehouse area AND water doesn't give freeze damage there
●	Fixed - Villa - Possibility to stuck in wall on save inside villa
●	Fixed - Bounty mele with auto loot will now not display Location to loot body


[h1]Beketov Valley[/h1]
●	Fixed - VIlla - Exfiltrate after challenge (second playthrough)
●	Improved - Challenge stealth kills changed to knife kills (interrogation, throwing knives, melee kills)
●	Fixed - Bounty mele kill with auto loot will now not display Location to loot body

[h1]Arakcheyev Fortres[/h1]
●	Improved - Enable layer activation - should improve slightly the performance
●	Fixed - Passing through layer switcher in Antanasia's bunker makes snow on pipes disappear
●	Fixed - Bounty melee kill with auto loot will now not display Location to loot body

[h1]Sibirskaya - 7 junction[/h1]
●	Fixed - VO are overlapping upon fast traveling to the location near the Fortress
●	Improved - Moved Interest Point so that NPC does not fall off the ledge
●	Fixed - Fuse Box in first outpost has no collision in main switcher box - Player can't destroy it by shooting, only to the doors of it
●	Fixed - Player may jump over the dam and get stuck there
●	Fixed - Vehicle explosion trigger challenge
●	Fixed - Bounty melEe kill with auto loot will now not display Location to loot body

Fixed multiple other small bugs related to level design on all maps. 

If you encounter any problem please contact us on support@cigames.com, we will do our best to fix them in next patch.
